design_overview: UniStudy is designed as a modern, student-focused mobile application with clean visual hierarchy and intuitive navigation. The design emphasizes collaboration, content discovery, and ease of use. The interface uses a card-based layout with clear CTAs, making it easy for students to share notes, join study groups, and engage in discussions. The color scheme is professional yet approachable, with purple as the primary brand color representing creativity and learning. All screens are designed for touch interaction with generous tap targets and clear visual feedback.

responsive_design: The design uses a mobile-first approach optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen widths from 375px to 428px. All touch targets are minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Cards and lists use flexible layouts that adapt to screen width. Bottom navigation remains fixed for easy thumb access. Horizontal scrolling sections allow content to extend beyond viewport. Typography scales proportionally, and spacing uses 8px grid system for consistency across devices.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for text. Icons are paired with labels for clarity. Form inputs include clear labels and placeholders. Error states use both color and text. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation supported for web version. Focus states clearly visible with primary color outlines.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: button press states with 0.2s scale animation, card taps with ripple effect, screen transitions use slide animations (300ms ease-out), bottom sheet modals slide up from bottom, FAB rotates 45° when active, loading states show skeleton screens, pull-to-refresh with spring animation, toast notifications slide in from top, tab switches with fade transition, and message send includes send icon animation.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style from Feather Icons or similar: home (house), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (like), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow). All icons are 24x24px with 2px stroke width, rendered in current text color for consistency.
